_source.describes: The Dungeons generator: its five axes, and the outcomes a d6 stocks a room with.
_source.status: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Games Omnivorous.
_source.rationale: The axes and the room-stocking procedure are FLAIL!'s mechanics, which the Third Party Licence permits this tool to implement. The entries are not, and none are copied or paraphrased from the book: every row here is original to this project. The stocking checklist FLAIL! uses is itself credited in-book to the Goblin Punch blog, so it is not Games Omnivorous's to license onward either — one more reason the wording of each outcome is written from scratch.
_source.attribution: FLAIL! Tools is an independent production by the flail-tools contributors and is not affiliated with Games Omnivorous. It is published under the Games Omnivorous Third Party Licence.

flavours: Picked clean a long time ago
locations: Under the roots of one great tree
keyFeatures: A shaft no torch reaches the bottom of
A door that has been bricked up twice
Water rising an inch a day
A stair that descends into itself
Bones sorted by size, in piles
One room kept clean and lit
creatures: Rats, in a single moving mass
Something blind that hunts by sound
A thing that wears the dead
stocking: A lock, a puzzle, or a choice
A clue about what is deeper down
